scope.BLEU: corpus BLEU; sentence BLEU separately retained, not averaged into corpus score
scope.NIST: corpus NIST-5 only; per-sample score unavailable in this scoring profile
scope.METEOR: mean sample METEOR, NLTK tokenized whitespace with WordNet
scope.ROUGE-L: sample average; CIDEr uses this whole corpus document frequencies
scope.CIDEr: sample average; CIDEr uses this whole corpus document frequencies
